argv:
sh -c 'printf "pid1="; IFS= read -r p < /proc/1/comm; printf "%s
" "$p"; printf "uid="; id -u; printf "root_controllers="; IFS= read -r p < /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers; printf "%s
" "$p"; printf "process_cgroup="; while IFS= read -r p; do printf "%s
" "$p"; done < /proc/self/cgroup; if [ -d /run/systemd/system ]; then printf "systemd_running=yes
"; else printf "systemd_running=no
"; fi'
stdout:
pid1=systemd
uid=1000
root_controllers=cpuset cpu io memory hugetlb pids rdma
process_cgroup=0::/non-systemd/user.slice/user-1000.slice/session-c219.scope
systemd_running=yes
scope: Read-only PID1/uid/cgroup facts; no sudo/write/restart/permission mutation; no credentials inspected
